## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Benign only; second model and neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1% | Clearly Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / percentile 1.0 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Benign | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Score well below typical; concept model reads this as less invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Gland formation scored high; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 2, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · High score; modest lower-invasive association · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Scored very low; small contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002, −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable [F4].

## Could be wrong if
- Input is a simulated resample-degraded image; reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Region 9 carries 64% per-region invasive risk; other regions are ≤14%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 9** — look for an invasive focus; per-region risk is 64%.
2. **Regions 2, 5, 7** — confirm atypical cells stay within ducts (in situ vs benign).
3. **Regions 1, 8, 11** — confirm gland architecture looks benign.
